name: claude-makerplace
description: Sanitized provenance summary for the public plugin package.

items.notes: Skill files are sanitized and stored under plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md.
Command files are stored under plugins/makerplace-system/commands.
Claude Code plugin agents are stored under plugin agents directories.
Hook definitions are stored under plugin hooks directories.
Codex and OpenCode adapters are thin compatibility layers over the Claude Code source layout. OpenCode also has an installable npm package entrypoint.
